novoe.zakrepit_text: The screenshot hangs on top of all windows like a sticky note: drag it, the wheel changes the size, Ctrl+wheel the transparency. The Pin button in the editor and in the selection window, or the F3 key.

zakrepit.tip:
Pin the screenshot on top of windows (F3)
The screenshot hangs in its own small window. Drag it with the mouse, the wheel changes the size, Ctrl+wheel the transparency, a double click or Esc closes it, the right button opens a menu
zakrepit.training: Practice image: it is not pinned on top of windows.
zakrepit.wayland_hint: This desktop may not keep the window on top. If it goes under others: Alt+Space, then “Always on Top”.
